run_cifar10_training: run the cifar10 tensorflow training script with configurable epochs and learning rate
run_cifar10_tensorboard: run cifar10 training with tensorboard logging enabled via tensorboard_log_dir flag
run_cifar10_distributed: run cifar10 training using tf.distribute.MirroredStrategy for multi-GPU training
run_cifar10_build_model: build a sequential CNN model with Conv2D, MaxPooling2D, Flatten, and Dense layers for cifar10
run_cifar10_compile: compile the cifar10 model with Adam optimizer and SparseCategoricalCrossentropy loss
